objective: Complete Automated-Play Recovery, Safety, Acceptance and Implementation Handoff by integrating APM-01 through APM-05 with APW-07 persistence/recovery architecture, defining interruption/stale/duplicate/out-of-scope/AI-failure/hidden-information behavior, deterministic replay/provenance, mode-transition acceptance and additive implementation destinations without granting unbounded automation or application implementation authority.
completion_gate: The complete automated-play design has explicit owning domains, persistence and authority boundaries, deterministic interruption/recovery/replay behavior, hidden-information and optional-AI safety, mode-transition acceptance cases and additive implementation destinations for Cozy Solo, Connected Cozy, AutoGM Encounter and AutoGM Mini-Campaign without unbounded or global automation authority.
required_design_questions: How do APM-01 controller authority/revocation rules interact with APW-07 stable operation IDs, expected versions, status lookup and Event recovery?
How do Cozy Solo activities recover after interruption without repeating rewards progress resource spending or choices?
How does Connected Cozy recover participant contributions, reservations, disconnects, leave/rejoin and permission changes without pooled authority or duplicate state?
How do AutoGM single encounters recover deterministic mechanics, reactions, hidden state and encounter completion after interruption?
How do AutoGM mini-campaign runs recover parent/child scene progression exactly once after an APM-03 child completes?
What stale-state and duplicate-Action behavior applies consistently across Cozy and AutoGM operations?
What happens when optional AI is unavailable, times out, returns an illegal suggestion or attempts to exceed authorized context?
What exact automation-out-of-scope attempts must be rejected rather than narrated or silently approximated?
How is hidden-information filtering applied before automation-controller and optional-AI projections, summaries, notifications and replay evidence?
How do Cozy ↔ ordinary Campaign and Personal contexts transition without forked state or implicit authority transfer?
How do Solo Cozy ↔ Connected Cozy transitions preserve personal ownership, shared history, participant consent and safe return?
How do AutoGM encounter ↔ mini-campaign transitions preserve encounter package/run identity, parent progression and deterministic replay?
What provenance/receipts identify mode, controller, package, operation, rules inputs, resulting Event and optional presentation assistance?
What deterministic acceptance fixtures prove same inputs produce the same mechanical outcomes while presentation may vary?
What implementation slices and feature flags should APM-06 hand to APW-08 without activating application implementation?
What explicit non-goals preserve future multiplayer AutoGM, broader autonomous campaigns, public matchmaking and paid AI as later work?
What mobile/accessibility/no-AI/zero-paid-service acceptance is mandatory across all automated modes?
next_action: Execute APM-06 as a bounded design/governance recovery safety acceptance and implementation-handoff tranche; do not begin it as part of the APW-07 completion handoff.
